dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I much prefer tranquil places like this to the constant clamor of the city.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: It's somewhere that I can be myself. No distractions.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: A life of freedom, leisure, and relative privacy... It seems this appeals to you, too.
